shortDefinition: The Bureau registry that stores published workflow definitions for Pearls to execute.

children.text: Process Catalog is served by the MANAGER Pearl. After Template Compiler validates a panel, the catalog exposes the resulting workflow to CLIENT and INSTANCE Pearls.
Provides versioned templates for execution and rollback.
Accessible over GraphQL for discovery and automation.
Feeds Panel Builder previews and published flows.

seo.title: Process Catalog (Bureau)
seo.description: Definition of the Process Catalog registry in Bureau.
